title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data from Sliced Chebyshev Moments
abstract: arXiv:2610.42081v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research on practical differentially private (DP) synthetic data has largely focused on methods that approximately preserve low-dimensional marginals of a target distribution, and can thus only hope to preserve higher-dimensional, global structure as a lucky by-product. At the same time, existing methods that target global accuracy guarantees pay a price exponential in the data dimension, $d$.   In this work, we address this ``curse of dimensionality'' by presenting a new DP synthetic data algorithm, SPLICE, that comes with a compelling global distributional guarantee, even in high-dimensions, and moreover, is practically state-of-the-art. Our algorithm is based on measuring noisy sliced Chebyshev polynomial moments of the target distribution and fitting a distribution to match, a twist on recent polynomial methods for 1-D synthetic data. translated_title: 基于切片切比雪夫矩的差分隐私合成数据
translated_abstract: 关于实用的差分隐私（DP）合成数据的研究大多集中在近似保持目标分布低维边缘分布的方法上，因而只能指望将高维全局结构作为幸运的副产品加以保留。与此同时，现有的以全局精度保证为目标的方法则需要付出随数据维度 $d$ 呈指数级增长的代价。在本工作中，我们通过提出一种新的 DP 合成数据算法 SPLICE 来应对这一“维度灾难”，该算法即使在高维情形下也具有出色的全局分布保证，并且在实践中达到了最先进的水平。我们的算法基于对目标分布的带噪切片切比雪夫多项式矩进行测量，并拟合一个分布来与之匹配，这是对近期用于一维合成数据的多项式方法的一种改进。我们证明，给定包含 $n$ 个样本的数据集，SPLICE 返回一个具有切片……的私有分布
tldr: SPLICE 是一种新的差分隐私合成数据算法，通过测量带噪切片切比雪夫多项式矩并拟合分布，即使在高维情形下也能提供全局分布保证并达到实践中的最先进性能，从而克服了维度灾难。
en_tdlr: SPLICE is a new differentially private synthetic data algorithm that measures noisy sliced Chebyshev polynomial moments and fits a matching distribution, providing compelling global distributional guarantees even in high dimensions while achieving state-of-the-art practical performance, thereby overcoming the curse of dimensionality.
